name: People Telecom
summary: ISP founded 2000; listed via reverse takeover of Swiftel; acquired by M2 Group in 2008 (PEOPLE TELECOM LIMITED, ACN 009 273 152).

events.details: Founded by Ryan O'Hare and Colin Marland.

refs.label: deListed Australia: People Telecom Limited (ASX:PEO) — delisted 1 May 2009 (M2 scheme of arrangement)

events.details: Perth/WA carve-out: People Telecom sold its WA fibre + DSL broadband customer base and ~600 sqm Perth datacentre to Amcom for A$6.25m (announced Mar 2007, completed Apr 2007) — separate from and before the 2008 whole-business sale to M2.

refs.label: ZDNet 6-Mar-2007: Amcom purchases People Telecom Perth fibre business (A$6.25m, 600 sqm DC)
